K_definition: K* = min |sigma| over admissible repairs with X=1 and Y=1 (declared grammar: one move per movable object, target never a corrective move, legal destinations); certified iff K_lb(MINK_STATIC_V2, teacher's full grammar) = K_lb(V1) = |verified witness|
acceptance: witness_v3 verdict CERTIFIED_MIN_K: X=1 (independent replay, teacher_long) and Y=1 (independent replay) for the full witness, Y(empty)=0, len(witness)=K_lb_v1=K_lb_v2=stratum K; n_objects<=20; objects in columns 3-7 (TRAIN support)

generators.K4-6: gen_deep.py (GENDEEP3, parking prior) seeds 20000-29999 (never used before), 20000 steps; layout K_lb must equal the stratum
generators.K9: anneal20.py (fixed target/goal, exactly 20 objects) with run seeds >= 100 (never used before), from fresh prune seeds; target/goal pairs with column-3-7 ceiling >= 9
generators.K12: same as K9 with KMIN=12; BLOCKED if no 20-object layout with K_lb >= 12 is found (ceiling audit: 13 only at ~37 objects; greedy 20-object max 9)

attempt_order: per stratum, candidate layouts in sha256('FINAL|root_id') order; caps: 150 layouts per K4-6 stratum, 400 for K9, until 5 accepted
novelty: layout fingerprint (cells + target + goal) not in G0/HIST_EXCLUSIONS.json, not in any engineering pool (16 old + pilot46 + k9eng) and not a near-duplicate: occupied-cell Jaccard <= 0.85 vs every engineering scene and every earlier accepted final scene
diversity: <= 2 accepted scenes per (target cell, goal cell) pair per stratum; reported features: n_objects, redundant objects, parking cells used, witness order
engineering_pool_excluded: ENG_*, ENG2_*, DEEP_* pilot46, DEEP9_* k9eng (never counted in the final 25)
